title: VERA — Verifiable Evaluation for Responsible AI
description:
Open-source, self-hosted evaluation engine and review dashboard for responsible-AI requirements: it turns a declared specification (registry of benchmarks to requirements, catalog of weights) into scored, traceable evidence, with a content digest pinned into every run. Ships the twelve measurable COMPL-AI requirements of the EU AI Act and a security-focused alternative specification.

Companion artifact of the paper "VERA: A Responsible AI Dashboard for Assessing LLM Deployments in Light of the EU AI Act", accepted at APSEC 2026 (Software Engineering in Practice track).
